idea: AgroIntel LatAm is a voice-first agricultural assistant that transforms how smallholder farmers and cooperatives report field problems. Instead of sending unstructured WhatsApp voice notes, farmers speak to a chatbot that transcribes and classifies their reports into structured categories like pests, diseases, or nutrient deficiencies, using a vocabulary optimized for local jargon and low-bandwidth environments. The system then creates geotagged, prioritized alerts for extension technicians, who receive actionable, searchable logs instead of hours of messy audio. This structured data becomes the backbone for coordinating on-site visits and tracking issue resolution, helping cooperatives deliver faster, more efficient technical assistance while building a rich dataset of farm-level problems.

selected_gap.title: Structured Voice-Based Reporting and Classification
selected_gap.pain: Smallholder farmers lack a systematic way to report field problems. They rely on chaotic WhatsApp groups or manual notebooks, leading to lost reports, no classification, and delayed response.
selected_gap.why_now: Advances in speech-to-text and NLP for low-resource languages, combined with widespread use of basic phones with voice messaging, make it feasible to build a voice-first interface.
selected_gap.evidence_needed: Interview 20 farmers to quantify time spent in current methods, error rates, and willingness to use voice. Assess accuracy of transcription in target languages.
selected_gap.risk: User adoption of voice interface, accuracy in noisy farm environments, and convincing farmers to switch from familiar WhatsApp.

idea: AgroIntel LatAm pivoted to a B2B platform for agricultural extension agencies and large cooperatives, enabling them to deploy a voice-first AI agent that smallholder farmers call to report field issues. The system automatically transcribes, classifies (pest, disease, drought, etc.), geotags, and creates prioritized tickets, routing them to the right field technician. The buyer pays a subscription per farmer covered, gaining a management dashboard to track response times, resolution rates, and aggregate agronomic data. This replaces fragmented WhatsApp and phone-call triage, reducing crop losses and optimizing extension resources.
